title: Interpolation results hamiltonian decay
description: How far H(R) has decayed by the edge of its Wigner-Seitz domain. A Bloch sum that has not decayed by its last term is the direct cause of error between mesh points.

outermost_shell_distance_bohr.description: |R| of the outermost shell of lattice vectors.

outermost_shell_size.description: How many lattice vectors share that distance.

outermost_shell_maximum_ry.description: The largest Bloch-sum term w_R |H_mn(R)| on that shell.

largest_hopping_ry.description: The largest term that varies with k: any R away from the origin, or m != n on site, so a rigid shift of the energy zero cannot move it.

ratio.description: outermost_shell_maximum_ry / largest_hopping_ry; zero when there is nothing to divide by.
